name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-int-as-byte-negative-1-p.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: Literal — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
## Module-level declarations: Function definition — Supports required-params
reason: The case asserts a runtime panic when casting an int parameter containing -1 to byte. Type casts, numeric literals and unary minus, required parameters, function calls, and local declarations are supported, with no restriction excluding failed numeric casts or their panic behavior.
test_design_notes: The @panic comment marks the expected runtime failure at the cast.
